navigation.desktop: Retain 88 px stage rail. Clicking another stage selects its first available tool as today and opens its named tool flyout. Clicking the active stage toggles its list. Selecting a sibling changes content in the existing drawer.
navigation.activeToolDisplay: Keep the current drawer icon, title, description, and close control as the single persistent tool identity.
navigation.siblingDiscovery: Vertical list of every stage tool; preserve availability reason and per-tool attention/result badges.
navigation.keyboard: Named stage triggers; Enter/Space opens; arrows/Home/End move among tool choices; Enter/Space selects; Escape closes and returns focus to trigger; selecting a tool returns focus to its heading.
navigation.pointer: Click works; optional hover may assist but cannot be required.
navigation.touch: Tap stage and tool. Below 640 px, use the existing drawer-sheet footprint for tool choice.
navigation.directDestinations: Open current RF result, vertical path profile, Run History/report source, and attention actions bypass the chooser.
navigation.lazyLoading: Flyout reads navigation metadata only. Existing dynamic imports remain behind tool selection.

keepVisible: CURRENT/STALE/HISTORICAL/UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED and short source Run when applicable
Run Sector or Evaluate Network in existing Plan/Simulate scope with unchanged readiness/disabled behavior

commandBar.resultShortcut: A compact Result state/source chip may open Results; do not keep a separate metric card in the global header.
commandBar.persistence: Version identity stays with Workspace; local autosave stays a separate, compact status and must not be confused with immutable Version save.

drawer.removeAfterReplacement: Permanent tool-tab row only; move sibling navigation/availability/attention to the rail flyout.
drawer.expectedDensityGain: 51 px desktop, 59 px phone before content.

mapToolbar.reason: Navigation and command-bar grouping already constitute a bounded 8B change; toolbar controls are context-dependent and carry map interaction semantics.

keepVisible: scientific standard and clause where needed for interpretation

responsiveContract.atOrAbove1280: Vertical rail plus anchored overlay flyout; no map resize.
responsiveContract.1024To1279: Same flyout; grouped compact context; keep lineage/result state.
responsiveContract.640To1023: Touch-sized rail popover; no hover requirement.
responsiveContract.below640: Bottom stage bar plus stage tool sheet in existing drawer footprint.
responsiveContract.all: No page routing, no horizontal overflow, current tool remains named, map remains inspectable.

mapFirstDecision: Keep A.T.O.M as a map-first workspace. All options that resize the map persistently or turn the application into pages/dashboard were rejected.
visualSimplificationRules: Do not keep a permanent bordered sibling-tab row inside the drawer.
Give each navigation level one job: stage in rail, tool in temporary flyout, capability in disclosure, method/source in provenance.
Keep one obvious active tool title in the drawer.
Group related metadata before adding another pill or border.
Prefer spacing, typography, and alignment before another container.
Keep result freshness and required scientific safety/applicability explicit.
Treat local draft autosave and immutable Version as separate states.
Do not move map-toolbar restructuring into 8B.

invarianceContract.stateOwnership: Navigation remains UI-only; reuse App's activeTool/drawer ownership.
